jobs.description:
Job Location:
This position will be located at Hawthorn Children's Pyschiatric Hospital, 1901 Pennsylvania Ave., St. Louis, MO 63133

Why You’ll Love This Position

Hawthorn Children’s Psychiatric Hospital is seeking a dependable, adaptable, and team-oriented full-time clinician to support operations in our Inpatient and Residential Programs. This dynamic position requires flexibility and willingness to work wherever support is most needed across our facility.

Hawthorn Children’s Psychiatric Hospital uses the Sanctuary Model to guide our interactions with our teammates and the care we provide to our consumers to promote healing, safety, and nonviolence. This is accomplished by following the foundations of the Sanctuary Model to provide trauma informed and responsive care.

This clinician is a member of the Social Service Department, providing individual, group, and family therapy along with case management for children and adolescents ages 6 to 18 who are admitted to Hawthorn for the treatment of mental health conditions and trauma. This team member will play an integral part in a multi-disciplinary team and will provide direct clinical services to our consumers and families as they work to reach their treatment goals.

This position reports to the Residential Treatment Coordinator and Chief of Clinical Services. The schedule is generally 8:00 am to 4:30 pm Monday through Friday, with the ability to flex schedule at times. This could be necessary to accommodate family treatment sessions, potentially one evening during the week to meet the needs of patients and families.

Minimum Qualifications

The qualified candidate will have a master’s degree in social work from an accredited university. This successful candidate will also possess Missouri licensure (LMSW or LCSW) or will commit to working toward licensure during their employment. Opportunities for Professional Licensure Supervision is available. Knowledge and expertise in evidence-based therapeutic practices such as Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), Cognitive Behavior Therapy (CBT), and other trauma-focused approaches preferred.

Lack of post‐secondary education will not be used as the sole basis denying consideration to any applicant.

The State of Missouri offers an excellent benefits package that includes a defined pension plan, generous amounts of leave and holiday time, and eligibility for health insurance coverage. Your total compensation is more than the dollars you receive in your paycheck. This tool provides a comprehensive view of benefits and more that are offered to prospective employees. The Total Compensation Calculator and other applicant resources can be found here.

Friendly and supportive work environment
Flexible schedule, and no requirement to work weekends or evenings (except potentially one evening per week if family schedules require it)
No on-call work
Generous and flexible options for time off
Collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team
Lower caseloads with increased ability for clinical work
Length of treatment for Inpatient consumers is between2-4 months add between 6-8 months in Residential, which helps solidify quality change for consumers
Clinical Skills Training and case consultation provided
Licensure supervision offered if needed

jobs.title: TDM Program Manager
jobs.description:
Alta Planning + Design seeks an experienced Program Manager (TDM Programs Associate I) located in metro Austin, TX. This role is a great opportunity for someone with experience, passion, and expertise in active, multimodal, and sustainable transportation. If you are looking to join an innovative organization and do work that connects people to places while advancing social justice, safety, and environmental resilience, apply with Alta today!

About Alta

Alta is a mission‑driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people‑centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.

Day to Day

Employing transportation demand management (TDM), business, and organizational development principles to direct and implement successful projects, programs, and initiatives in support of the Capital Area Metropolitan Planning Organization (CAMPO) regional TDM program.
Shaping and implementing programs focused on shifting travel behaviors of a diverse group of commuters and communities, with particular focus on construction-related impacts and non-drive alone commutes. This may include supporting employers and their workforce in warehousing, logistics, hospitality, retail, technology, and more.
Effectively leading regional coordination meetings through presentations, meeting notes and summaries, and consistent follow up; developing action items and updating work plans.
Directing and participating in employer-facing outreach with the support and collaboration of stakeholders and other team members.
Leading, planning, and assisting outreach efforts such as presentations to large groups, transportation fairs, kiosks/expos, tabling, lunch and learns, and other in-person engagement tactics.
Supporting data collection tasks required to inform program measurement and evaluation, with a strong data-led approach to decision-making.
Managing partners, stakeholders, and/or sub-consultants through use of high level project management methods and responsible leadership of program tasks and deliverables.
Supporting public involvement and engagement strategies to effectively reach broad audiences. This may include navigating crucial conversations regarding under-resourced communities, vulnerable populations, and underrepresented demographics.
Establishing and nurturing long-term relationships with clients, including understanding needs, expectations, and challenges and ensuring clients feel valued, understood, and supported.
Overseeing implementation of the CAMPO SchoolPool program, including coordination with schools and partners, management of program data and processes, development of outreach materials, and tracking of timelines and milestones to support successful program launch and delivery.
Building and maintaining relationships with transportation and community leaders across the Austin metro region (and possibly across north and central Texas), including opportunities to collaborate on impactful transportation projects.
Helping advance Alta’s mission in Texas through identifying and leading business development opportunities
Actively engaging in continuous learning and integrating this knowledge into projects, including an understanding of emerging tools and techniques in the marketing field as they apply to our work. This involves attending trainings, workshops, and regional conferences as well as self-guided learning.

Qualifications

Required

This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (an advanced degree is a bonus)
Eight or more years of full-time professional experience, including five or more years of experience directly in TDM, city planning, public engagement, or transportation advocacy.
Ability to pass a Homeland Security background check
Experience working for a consulting firm, improvement district, or in a similar multi-client environment is preferred.
Project management software (e.g., Asana, Wrike, Basecamp, etc.).
Budget management tools (e.g. Deltek)
Microsoft Office tools (e.g., Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
General understanding of other platforms that directly aid in program delivery.
Relevant transportation and community data tools and sources.

Preferred

There are a number of additional skills, experience, and education that would be beneficial to this position including, but not limited to:

Advanced degree in a relevant field.
Knowledgeable (or highly curious) about related fields including behavior change, sustainability, transportation, TDM, city planning, community development, and economic development.
Active participation in industry-relevant professional associations and committees.
Experience managing large projects for both private and public clients.
Desire to positively affect the community, region, and environment.

What We Offer

Flexible Schedule

Alta offers a flexible, hybrid work schedule where most employees work from home three days per week. In-office days support our collaborative culture, one of our core values.

Compensation

The pay range for this job in Austin is $80,000-$100,000
annually. Placement within the range is based upon experience, skill sets, and qualifications.

Benefits

Alta offers comprehensive benefits to all full-time employees:

Medical: PPO or HSA medical plans, Alta pays 75% of the cost
Dental/Vision: PPO, Alta pays 90% of the cost
Life Insurance: Alta pays 100% of the premium for life and AD&D, equal to your base compensation
401(k): Alta provides a safe harbor match up to 4%
PTO: 21 days accrued annually to start
Holidays: 11 total company paid holidays
Paid Parental Leave/Short-Term Disability
Additional Benefits: Wellness reimbursement up to $800 annually, Alta Gets Around benefit of up to $900 annually, 5-year travel award, and professional development opportunities

jobs.title: Justice System Program Manager, Bangladesh
jobs.description:
Who We Are

International Justice Mission (IJM) is a global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable.

We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve.

The Need

For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a Justice System Program Manager, who will provide guidance to all the casework team from Bangladesh (Dhaka, Khulna, Mymensingh and Barishal division) and develop strategies to ensure effective and timely prosecution of IJMs cases, strengthen partnerships with the key legal stakeholders to bring the cases through to conviction. The position will report to the Director, Justice System Program.

This role leads the development and implementation of strategic legal interventions to strengthen the response of first responders and justice sector stakeholders in addressing Commercial Sexual Exploitation of Children (CSEC) and advancing IJM’s 2030 goals. The position provides training, technical guidance, and best practices to improve justice system outcomes, while working closely with the Regional Justice Solutions Team, Divisional Directors, casework teams, and partner organizations. The role also supports capacity building, legal strategy implementation, and stakeholder engagement, and requires regular field and court visits with extensive travel across district and divisional levels.

The role is based in Dhaka, but will provide support nationally, including travelling to each of IJM’s future program locations (Khulna, Barisal and Mymensingh).

Responsibilities:

Strategy, Knowledge Development, & Implementation:

Lead and support the design and implementation of legal strategies within justice system transformation projects.
Represent the legal function in project planning, coordination, and strategic initiatives.
Develop legal tools, best practices, and innovative approaches to strengthen case outcomes and victim protection.
Mentor advocates and provide legal compliance guidance to internal teams and partners.
Strengthen the capacity of the criminal justice system to address trafficking and CSEC cases.
Ensure alignment of IJM global legal standards with Bangladesh’s legal framework and legal practices.
Support implementation of IJM’s Protection Model and effective legal interventions.
Provide technical legal expertise, casework support, and strategic guidance to legal teams and partners.
Promote and scale effective legal models, tools, and frameworks across programs.
Support the adoption of global and regional legal standards, resources, and best practices.

Networking & Partnership:

Build and maintain strategic partnerships with legal, judicial, and government stakeholders to strengthen anti-trafficking and CSEC responses.
Develop legal tools, resources, and training materials to support internal teams and external partners.
Represent IJM at legal forums, conferences, and key stakeholder engagements.
Promote the adoption of legal best practices and strengthen partner capacity.
Analyze case and program data to inform reporting and improve justice system outcomes.
Facilitate partnerships and MoUs with academic, judicial, and strategic institutions to advance child protection and anti-trafficking efforts.

Communication:

Development of briefs, papers, fact sheets, and other communication resources as necessary; that articulates IJM’s approach and strategy for Legal casework.
Consistently communicate with IJM legal teams and field leaders about the trends and changes on the legal aspects of human trafficking and protection model across the regions.
Conduct periodical meetings with the National and Divisional legal team to identify the needs, provide feedback on case development, legal strategies, team management, and policy compliances.
Conduct regular meetings with national and specialists to identify the requirements to enhance the capacity of the legal team to achieve IJM’s 2030 vision.
Connect with the National and Divisional Program Directors to give and receive feedback on legal team performance.
Communicate legal Field priorities to the Director, Justice System Program and work towards the alignment on IJM’s 2030 vision strategy.

Policies & Procedures:

Collaborate with the National, South Asia Leadership team and the Divisional Legal team to facilitate the development of comprehensive Legal policies, procedures and best practices.
Provide legal expertise and strategic inputs into various aspects, such as procedures, research, curriculum, contracts, or MOUs, resulting in rigorous and legally sound research, drafting, and decision making.
Collect regional best practices/learnings for Legal casework and support.

Training and Development:

Develop and deliver legal training modules for IJM staff and legal teams on best practices and legal interventions.
Build the capacity of divisional legal staff to support IJM’s 2030 vision.
Facilitate training, coaching, and mentoring on human trafficking and CSEC investigations.
Adapt global legal tools and training materials to the Bangladesh context.
Support capacity building within the criminal justice system and contribute to the development of IJM training resources.
Develop legal tools, resources, and training materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Conduct in-person training sessions for staff, partners, and other stakeholders as required.

Research, Program Management, and M&E:

Engage in research projects as needed to provide legal expertise.
Provide knowledge and advisory services on legal procedures to Partners and CSOs.
Oversee the research on various legal matters as needed and provide recommendations to the policies, manuals, and procedures.
Monitor that Legal activities (internal & with partners) are being implemented well.

Documentation, Reporting & Data Management:

Monitor Legal Data Collection and Analysis.
Ensure that all copies of letters and documents submitted to the judiciary are stored in the data center on a regular basis.
Bring relevant issues/needs to the attention of Director of Justice System Program.
To be efficient and expert in handling JDS and other technical tools of IJM.
Excellent in drafting letters and legal correspondence.
Expert in matters pertaining to court and legal issues.

Casework:

Mentor and support IJM lawyers and justice officials to build strong cases and promote justice for trafficking survivors.
Prepare and support survivors through legal proceedings using a trauma-informed approach.
Implement IJM’s protection model throughout legal processes and court proceedings.
Coordinate with government agencies, partners, and internal teams to ensure survivor safety and security.
Work with investigators to collect and preserve admissible evidence in trafficking and child exploitation cases.
Collaborate with Aftercare Specialists to address survivors' psychosocial needs.
Support the hosting of guests, visitors, and volunteers as needed.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in law (LL.B.) required; Master’s degree (LL.M.) preferred.
Strong knowledge of Bangladesh criminal, anti-trafficking, and child protection laws.
7+ years of legal experience in criminal litigation, trial advocacy, or corporate legal practice.
4+ years of leadership experience, preferably managing legal teams or advocates.
Excellent legal research, drafting, and advocacy skills.
Experience in project design and implementation.
Demonstrated commitment to human rights and social justice.

Technical Competencies:

Support IJM advocates (full-time and contractual) and assists public prosecutors in CSEC and Trafficking case hearings, including bail, pre-trial, trial, and appeal proceedings.
Guide advocates in achieving deterrence through arrests, restraints, bail cancellations, and convictions.
Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex legal concepts.
Conduct training and capacity-building initiatives.
Manage budgets and resources effectively.
Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team development support.
Apply international and cross-cultural legal experience in diverse environments.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
Provide field-based support and capacity building to partners to strengthen State and District team effectiveness.

Non-Technical Competencies:

Strong multicultural awareness and ability to work effectively across diverse environments
Committed to IJM’s mission, values, and professionalism.
Humble servant leader with integrity and ethical conduct.
Innovative, courageous, and solutions-oriented.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage priorities effectively.
Able to perform under pressure while maintaining professionalism.
Collaborative, adaptable, and service-minded team player.

Application Process:

Upload Resume & Cover Letter in one PDF document and send the application to bangladeshrecruitment@ijm.org

IJM holds strict safeguarding principles and a zero tolerance to violations of the Safeguarding
Policy, Protection against Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment Policy, and Code of Ethics. Hawthorn Children’s Psychiatric Hospital is seeking a dependable, adaptable, and team-oriented full-time clinician to support operations in our Inpatient and Residential Programs. This dynamic position requires flexibility and willingness to work wherever support is most needed across our facility.

Hawthorn Children’s Psychiatric Hospital uses the Sanctuary Model to guide our interactions with our teammates and the care we provide to our consumers to promote healing, safety, and nonviolence. This clinician is a member of the Social Service Department, providing individual, group, and family therapy along with case management for children and adolescents ages 6 to 18 who are admitted to Hawthorn for the treatment of mental health conditions and trauma. This team member will play an integral part in a multi-disciplinary team and will provide direct clinical services to our consumers and families as they work to reach their treatment goals.

This position reports to the Residential Treatment Coordinator and Chief of Clinical Services. Opportunities to participate in different committees within the facility

Alta Planning + Design seeks an experienced Program Manager (TDM Programs Associate I) located in metro Austin, TX. This role is a great opportunity for someone with experience, passion, and expertise in active, multimodal, and sustainable transportation. If you are looking to join an innovative organization and do work that connects people to places while advancing social justice, safety, and environmental resilience, apply with Alta today!

About Alta

Alta is a mission‑driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people‑centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.

Day to Day

new_jobs.title: Justice System Program Manager, Bangladesh
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

International Justice Mission (IJM) is a global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable.

We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve.

The Need

For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a Justice System Program Manager, who will provide guidance to all the casework team from Bangladesh (Dhaka, Khulna, Mymensingh and Barishal division) and develop strategies to ensure effective and timely prosecution of IJMs cases, strengthen partnerships with the key legal stakeholders to bring the cases through to conviction. The position will report to the Director, Justice System Program.

This role leads the development and implementation of strategic legal interventions to strengthen the response of first responders and justice sector stakeholders in addressing Commercial Sexual Exploitation of Children (CSEC) and advancing IJM’s 2030 goals. The position provides training, technical guidance, and best practices to improve justice system outcomes, while working closely with the Regional Justice Solutions Team, Divisional Directors, casework teams, and partner organizations. The role also supports capacity building, legal strategy implementation, and stakeholder engagement, and requires regular field and court visits with extensive travel across district and divisional levels.

The role is based in Dhaka, but will provide support nationally, including travelling to each of IJM’s future program locations (Khulna, Barisal and Mymensingh).

Responsibilities:

Strategy, Knowledge Development, & Implementation:

Lead and support the design and implementation of legal strategies within justice system transformation projects.
Represent the legal function in project planning, coordination, and strategic initiatives.
Develop legal tools, best practices, and innovative approaches to strengthen case outcomes and victim protection.
Mentor advocates and provide legal compliance guidance to internal teams and partners.
Strengthen the capacity of the criminal justice system to address trafficking and CSEC cases.
Ensure alignment of IJM global legal standards with Bangladesh’s legal framework and legal practices.
Support implementation of IJM’s Protection Model and effective legal interventions.
Provide technical legal expertise, casework support, and strategic guidance to legal teams and partners.
Promote and scale effective legal models, tools, and frameworks across programs.
Support the adoption of global and regional legal standards, resources, and best practices.

Networking & Partnership:

Build and maintain strategic partnerships with legal, judicial, and government stakeholders to strengthen anti-trafficking and CSEC responses.
Develop legal tools, resources, and training materials to support internal teams and external partners.
Represent IJM at legal forums, conferences, and key stakeholder engagements.
Promote the adoption of legal best practices and strengthen partner capacity.
Analyze case and program data to inform reporting and improve justice system outcomes.
Facilitate partnerships and MoUs with academic, judicial, and strategic institutions to advance child protection and anti-trafficking efforts.

Communication:

Development of briefs, papers, fact sheets, and other communication resources as necessary; that articulates IJM’s approach and strategy for Legal casework.
Consistently communicate with IJM legal teams and field leaders about the trends and changes on the legal aspects of human trafficking and protection model across the regions.
Conduct periodical meetings with the National and Divisional legal team to identify the needs, provide feedback on case development, legal strategies, team management, and policy compliances.
Conduct regular meetings with national and specialists to identify the requirements to enhance the capacity of the legal team to achieve IJM’s 2030 vision.
Connect with the National and Divisional Program Directors to give and receive feedback on legal team performance.
Communicate legal Field priorities to the Director, Justice System Program and work towards the alignment on IJM’s 2030 vision strategy.

Policies & Procedures:

Collaborate with the National, South Asia Leadership team and the Divisional Legal team to facilitate the development of comprehensive Legal policies, procedures and best practices.
Provide legal expertise and strategic inputs into various aspects, such as procedures, research, curriculum, contracts, or MOUs, resulting in rigorous and legally sound research, drafting, and decision making.
Collect regional best practices/learnings for Legal casework and support.

Training and Development:

Develop and deliver legal training modules for IJM staff and legal teams on best practices and legal interventions.
Build the capacity of divisional legal staff to support IJM’s 2030 vision.
Facilitate training, coaching, and mentoring on human trafficking and CSEC investigations.
Adapt global legal tools and training materials to the Bangladesh context.
Support capacity building within the criminal justice system and contribute to the development of IJM training resources.
Develop legal tools, resources, and training materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Conduct in-person training sessions for staff, partners, and other stakeholders as required.

Research, Program Management, and M&E:

Engage in research projects as needed to provide legal expertise.
Provide knowledge and advisory services on legal procedures to Partners and CSOs.
Oversee the research on various legal matters as needed and provide recommendations to the policies, manuals, and procedures.
Monitor that Legal activities (internal & with partners) are being implemented well.

Documentation, Reporting & Data Management:

Monitor Legal Data Collection and Analysis.
Ensure that all copies of letters and documents submitted to the judiciary are stored in the data center on a regular basis.
Bring relevant issues/needs to the attention of Director of Justice System Program.
To be efficient and expert in handling JDS and other technical tools of IJM.
Excellent in drafting letters and legal correspondence.
Expert in matters pertaining to court and legal issues.

Prepare and support survivors through legal proceedings using a trauma-informed approach.
Implement IJM’s protection model throughout legal processes and court proceedings.
Coordinate with government agencies, partners, and internal teams to ensure survivor safety and security.
Work with investigators to collect and preserve admissible evidence in trafficking and child exploitation cases.
Collaborate with Aftercare Specialists to address survivors' psychosocial needs.
Support the hosting of guests, visitors, and volunteers as needed.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in law (LL.B.) required; Master’s degree (LL.M.) preferred.
Strong knowledge of Bangladesh criminal, anti-trafficking, and child protection laws.
7+ years of legal experience in criminal litigation, trial advocacy, or corporate legal practice.
4+ years of leadership experience, preferably managing legal teams or advocates.
Excellent legal research, drafting, and advocacy skills.
Experience in project design and implementation.
Demonstrated commitment to human rights and social justice.

Technical Competencies:

Support IJM advocates (full-time and contractual) and assists public prosecutors in CSEC and Trafficking case hearings, including bail, pre-trial, trial, and appeal proceedings.
Guide advocates in achieving deterrence through arrests, restraints, bail cancellations, and convictions.
Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex legal concepts.
Conduct training and capacity-building initiatives.
Manage budgets and resources effectively.
Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team development support.
Apply international and cross-cultural legal experience in diverse environments.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
Provide field-based support and capacity building to partners to strengthen State and District team effectiveness.

Humble servant leader with integrity and ethical conduct.
Innovative, courageous, and solutions-oriented.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage priorities effectively.
Able to perform under pressure while maintaining professionalism.
Collaborative, adaptable, and service-minded team player.
